explicit_contract.state_and_recovery: open_state_dir owns locked private Unix state; claim verifies Ed25519 and syncs nonce consumption before dispatch, while with_verified_use rechecks live epoch/revocation under the same lock before callback entry. Uncertain persistence fences the handle.
remaining_work: Host trust, current revocation distribution and backup anti-rollback remain external owner responsibilities; equivalent non-Unix ACL storage is not implemented.
explicit_contract.source_non_unix_behavior: The non-Unix prepare_directory/open_private/entry_exists/replace functions in prompt-registry durable state, final-use state and authority leases explicitly return UnsafeStateDirectory. This behavior must not be changed into success merely to satisfy CI.
explicit_contract.directory_durability: GAP_CLOSURE_IMPLEMENTATION says Windows parent-directory durability remains unresolved and cannot be inferred from a no-op or a file-only flush. NDU_SYSTEM_EXECUTION and OBJECTIVE_TARGET_HOST_MEASUREMENT separately retain non-Unix target-host qualification boundaries.
